project_type: TypeScript/React monorepo managed with pnpm, deployed on Vercel
build_system: pnpm workspaces with Vite bundler. The deployable app is in artifacts/electron/ which shares source with root src/. Production vite config is artifacts/electron/vite.config.ts. Vercel output dir: artifacts/electron/dist/public.
test_framework: No test runner configured in the electron artifact. Unit tests exist as .test.ts files with node:assert.
build_command: pnpm run build (runs typecheck first, then vite build in artifacts/electron)
verification_instructions: Run pnpm run typecheck from workspace root to verify all TypeScript compiles. The build command runs typecheck first.
environment_constraints: Network may be limited. Use pnpm with existing node_modules. No docker available.
contribution_requirements: Standard TypeScript strict mode. Build must pass typecheck.
key_patterns: React.lazy for code splitting, manual chunks in vite rollup config, dynamic import('gsap') in hooks (useCinematicEntrance, useChromaSpotlight), lightningcss for CSS. Both vite.config.ts (root) and artifacts/electron/vite.config.ts need to stay in sync for manual chunks.
directory_structure: Root: monorepo. artifacts/electron/: deployed Vite app. src/: shared source. src/app/: App shell, providers, preload. src/components/: UI components (ui/, effects/, movies/, places/, memories/, messages/, quiz/, spin-match/, spin-wheel/). src/hooks/: custom hooks. src/services/: API and state. src/branding/: logo components. lib/: shared libraries.
